name: branding-dark-design-language-phone-tablet-laptop-board
title: Dark Design Language Multi-Device Board
whatItIs: A dark slate page titled Brand & Design Language with a plane progress bar, a paragraph, a tile of a phone with a camera back, a tablet on a black rock with a dashboard and a laptop with a light landing page, and coloured tiles peeking below.
whatItMeans: Showing phone, tablet and laptop together proves one visual system across devices, and the dark base makes the light UIs stand out.
techniques: Three devices in three different tiles
Rock as a natural base for the tablet
Blue highlight on the word Design Language
Plane marker on the progress bar

vocabulary.definition: The visual and interaction rules that make a product feel consistent.
A tile showing the design on one device type.
A bar showing position within a document.
